title: How this app works
intro: A few things are the same at every step. Read this carefully once before you start.

sections.title: Two ways to use this
bullets: Modules is the course: a video for each part, and the workbook as a PDF to download and print. Watch, download, and work on paper if that suits you.
Exercises is the same workbook inside the app: your answers are saved, your AI partner sits beside you, and you can print your result at the end.
Both lead to the same place. Use one, or both — people do it differently, and neither is the odd one out.
The navigation bar holds the four places the app is made of: Modules, Exercises, AI and Settings. Help lives in Settings.

sections.title: How each exercise works
bullets: Every exercise follows the same pattern. First the explanation, then "Now you". Some exercises include an optional "Go deeper" section. Use it when you have the time and energy.
The people in the examples are made up. They show what an answer can look like. Your answers can be completely different.
There are no perfect answers. "I don't know yet" is an honest answer. Write it down, along with how you could find out.
Write in your own language if you prefer.
Each part ends with "What does this tell me?" Use your answers to complete a short summary.
"Talk about it" boxes help you discuss your plans with your partner, family, friends, people in the network, or me.

sections.title: What the app does for you
bullets: Your answers are saved while you write. You can stop in the middle of a sentence and come back next week.
Every page shows where you are in the step, and the pages of that part sit at the bottom, so you can jump straight to one.
Your AI partner is available with each step. It helps you think. You decide and you write.
Under "What my AI partner knows" you can read the notes it keeps, correct them, or make it forget a topic.
You can delete everything you ever wrote, at any time, in one go.
At the end of a step you can print your result, or save it as a PDF.
Open "Why this exercise" to get an explanation for each exercise.
A short question about a step, or something that will not work? Ask me from Help, in Settings. I answer by email.

sections.title: The videos
bullets: Each part has a short video where I explain the same ideas in my own words. You find them under Modules, with the workbook for that step. Watch first, then answer the questions.
The video and the written explanation say the same thing. Use whichever suits you.

closing: Stuck on a question? Skip it and come back later. The answer often comes while you walk, cook or shower.
